typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePathFPA_Deliveries as string ('\\ csl831nvs1.wellsfargo.com\\1EQSUAT\\1EQSDEV\\WFSOpsKRIReporting\\DropZone\\Calypso\\FPA_Deliveries\\FLOAT_MO_DELIVERIES_SET10-15-2025.csv'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Purchase Dt} as date,
		{Settle Date} as date,
		{Trade Id} as string,
		{External Ref } as string,
		{Counter Party} as string,
		{Security Code} as string,
		Description as string,
		Price as string,
		{Withd Dt} as date,
		{Maturity Amt} as string,
		{Face Amt} as string,
		{Payment Amt} as string,
		Yield as string,
		DayCount as string,
		{Cmp Freq} as string,
		{Scheduled Cash} as string,
		Interest as string,
		{Scheduled Deposit Date} as date,
		{Scheduled Withdrawal Date} as date,
		{Payment Method} as string,
		Remark as string,
		{Pay Receive} as string,
		{Deliverable Types} as string,
		{Eligible Types} as string,
		{Max Index} as string,
		{Dis Max Fwd} as string,
		PV as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		FileName = toString((substring(toString($FilePathFPA_Deliveries), toInteger(87), toInteger(33)))),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FilePathFPA_Deliveries), toInteger(110), toInteger(10))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MaturityAmt as string,
		Description as string,
		WithdDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PV as string,
		ExternalRef as string,
		Load_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Remark as string,
		Interest as string,
		DisMaxFwd as string,
		FaceAmt as string,
		DayCount as string,
		MaxIndex as string,
		SettleDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SecurityCode as string,
		TradeId as string,
		ScheduledDepositDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ScheduledCash as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		PayReceive as string,
		EligibleTypes as string,
		CmpFreq as string,
		Price as string,
		PaymentAmt as string,
		PurchaseDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PaymentMethod as string,
		DeliverableTypes as string,
		Yield as string,
		ScheduledWithdrawalDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MaturityAmt = {Maturity Amt},
		Description,
		WithdDate = {Withd Dt},
		PV,
		ExternalRef = {External Ref },
		Load_Date = LoadDate,
		Remark,
		Interest,
		DisMaxFwd = {Dis Max Fwd},
		FaceAmt = {Face Amt},
		DayCount,
		MaxIndex = {Max Index},
		SettleDate = {Settle Date},
		SecurityCode = {Security Code},
		TradeId = {Trade Id},
		ScheduledDepositDate = {Scheduled Deposit Date},
		ScheduledCash = {Scheduled Cash},
		CounterParty = {Counter Party},
		PayReceive = {Pay Receive},
		EligibleTypes = {Eligible Types},
		CmpFreq = {Cmp Freq},
		Price,
		PaymentAmt = {Payment Amt},
		PurchaseDate = {Purchase Dt},
		PaymentMethod = {Payment Method},
		DeliverableTypes = {Deliverable Types},
		Yield,
		ScheduledWithdrawalDate = {Scheduled Withdrawal Date}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
